opennyai_summary.decision:
2. Reply affidavit is filed by the Sub-Divisional Officer, Karad on 28 March 2024 wherein following stand is taken:
"3. I say that a fresh proposal for acquisition of the Petitioner's Land under Act 2013 is received by this office through Hon'ble District Collector Satara by 3 49-wp4942-2022.doc letter dated 13/01/2023 as provided in Exhibit A which is under process.
4. I say that at present the General Lok Sabha Election 2024 are declared, this office head as well as office staff of this office has been allotted election duties, hence acquisition procedure would be carried on after Lok Sabha Election."
3. The reference to the elections in only in respect of manpower.
In light thereof, we are not inclined to accept that the steps to be taken have to be tied up with the process of elections.
4. Accordingly, it is directed that the necessary steps to initiate the acquisition proceedings in respect of the subject land be taken within a period of four weeks.
6. The Writ Petition accordingly stands disposed of in above terms.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
There is no embargo on the Authorities of the Sate to proceed for performance of their statutory duties.
In fact, the Petitioners are before us because the Respondents have failed to act in furtherance of their statutory duties since the year 2009 and it is because of this delay that we had passed order on 11 March 2024.
